MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='NaiveMovingAverage', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ARIMA dominates trend tracking (corr=1.0) and has lowest RMSE, while NaiveMovingAverage best captures seasonality (corr=0.527). High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio=0.99) and unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.345) justify robust combiners like median/trimmed mean. Early specialists (DWT_rf) and late specialists (ARIMA) show horizon-specific performance gaps.
